subject: They will never stop coming for our right to vote

body:
Opponents of voting rights lack the common sense to understand that these anti-voting conspiracy theories are just flat-out lies. They'd rather see a vast web of shadowy interests arrayed against them than reexamine their own values when they lose elections.
That's why they create bills like the SAVE America, SAVE, and MEGA Acts, to strip our fundamental right to vote until only their select few have the privilege to vote. They simply don't believe we all deserve to vote.
Step up with $35 or more right now to stop the SAVE Act and defend our right to vote from these vicious attacks >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052426_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
KATU: Vance calls on Congressional Republicans to pass SAVE Act during speech [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052426_2&amount=25]
Opponents of voting rights are trying everything they can think of to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address Trump's often-repeated -- and equally debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud. Vice President J.D. Vance called on Congress again this week, begging them to pass this awful bill ahead of the next election.
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now, Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052426_2&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
Team, the consequences of a bill like this passing would be catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $35 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052426_2&amount=35]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=052426_2&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=052426_2&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=052426_2&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=052426_2&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=052426_2&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=052426_2&amount=35]
How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. "
Team, the lies aren't going to stop, but we can push back and make sure bills like this abomination never pass. Pitch in $35 or however much you can to stand against voter suppression bills in Congress and beyond >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=052426_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

name: Barlow For Wyo
subject: Barlow For Wyoming Newsletter
body:
Newsletter
| | | | | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KSE761QB2BESTKV6K14SSVMA_0)
---
| **Welcome to the Barlow for Wyoming Newsletter. Your hub for latest news, information and upcoming events.**
---
|
---
| | |
---
| ENERGY FORWARD
---
| Hi friends, These past few weeks were another reminder of what makes Wyoming special. Everywhere Kelly and I traveled, we met people investing in their communities, building businesses, mentoring young people, supporting local jobs, and thinking seriously about the future of our state. One thing I’ve always appreciated about Wyoming Republicans is that we still understand politics starts with neighbors talking to neighbors. Real conversations about how we keep Wyoming the best place to live, work, raise a family, and build a future. Spending time around the state has shown me that this idea is still important to our citizens. That spirit is on display. From Lincoln Day gatherings and community events to conversations about energy, entrepreneurship, and workforce development, there’s a shared understanding that Wyoming succeeds when people stay involved, work together, and keep showing up for their communities. We have had more support come our way from the energy industry. Nathan McLeland from M&K Oil is someone I have known and worked with regularly, and we have accomplished a lot for energy together. I have always believed Wyoming has an opportunity to lead, not follow, when it comes to powering America’s future. Our energy workers, producers, engineers, and communities have helped build this country for generations, and Wyoming should never be afraid to stand behind the industries and people who keep the lights on. From innovative companies to energy leaders to volunteers and community organizations helping young people across the state, a lot is happening in Wyoming energy worth believing in. I am also continuing to show up and do the Senate work I was elected to do. This meant attending the Transportation Committee in Casper. There are still critical interim conversations to be had. Thank you to everyone who welcomed us over the past few weeks, shared ideas, hosted events, and continues to support this campaign. We’re grateful for the chance to keep earning your trust one town at a time. \- Eric
---
| | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KSE761QB2BESTKV6K14SSVMA_1)
---
| **In Case You Missed It** I formally filed to be your next Republican Governor last Saturday. I had some great backup from the Cody Youth for Justice group and Kelly.

As election day nears, the campaign will be working hard to reach each voter across the state, and to do that, we could use your support!

Consider chipping in today!
---

[Politics in park prove positive](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KSE761QB2BESTKV6K14SSVMA_4) Your Wyoming Link [Gubernatorial candidate Eric Barlow focuses on Wyoming’s future](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KSE761QB2BESTKV6K14SSVMA_5) Oil City News [Natrona County students share concerns with gubernatorial candidate at Thursday event](https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01KSE761QB2BESTKV6K14SSVMA_6)
---
|
---
| |
---
| -American Legion Memorial Day Service, Monday, May 25 · 10-11AM, Jackson Town Square, 10 E Broadway, Jackson, WY -Hootenany at the Pink Garter Theater, Monday, May 25 · 5:30 - 9PM
50 W Broadway, Jackson, WY -Coffee with the Barlows, Wednesday, May 27 · 6–9 AM Fossil Fuel Coffee Company, 819 S Main St, Kemmerer, WY
Economic Opportunities & Challenges -May 27, 12-1:30PM, Holiday Inn, 1675 Sunset Dr., Rock Springs
-Lunch at Marbleton Senior Center, Thursday, May 28 · 11:30 - 1PM 429 2nd St, Big Piney, WY

-"Community Concert for Hope" Orr's Hope Foundation, Thursday, May 28, 5-8PM, N David Street, Casper, WY
---
| **On The Trail**
---
|
---
| | | GILLETTE
As a former educator who continues to work with youth at all levels, Kelly wasn't missing a chance to read to students from the local elementary schools in Campbell County through the Wyoming Reads Program. Each student gets to go home with the book they have chosen. Such a great experience!
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | LARAMIE
I attended the Wyoming Energy Authority's Next Frontier Energy Summit in Laramie. It's a key event that offers Wyoming's energy stakeholders a place to learn, collaborate, and network as they build the future of Wyoming's economy.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | CASPER
We got a tour of the Wyo Sports Ranch. It was good to see firsthand what the project is bringing to Casper and the surrounding community. Developments like this help create opportunity, support local businesses, and keep communities moving forward. Then we stopped by DISA Technologies with Greyson Buckingham and John Lee. They launched the company after getting their start through the UW Ellbogen $50K Entrepreneurship Competition, and they're doing some really innovative work in mineral recovery and mine remediation. It's always good to see Wyoming people building businesses, creating jobs, and deciding to do it here at home instead of somewhere else. I appreciate getting tours and the chance to meet the teams behind the work.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| **CASPER**
---
| | | Kelly and I had a great time in Casper. Jan and Brad Cundy hosted us at the Boys & Girls Club of Glenrock, where we had the chance to hear from Anthony Robles. Anthony shared his story and the message behind his book and the new Netflix film Unstoppable. It was great to see the impact an event like this can have on young people and the community.
Then we stopped by High Country Fabrication in Casper. I always appreciate the opportunity to meet the people behind Wyoming businesses and see the work being done firsthand. Businesses like this help support local jobs, strengthen communities, and keep Wyoming moving forward.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | WORLAND It was great to join Republicans in Washakie County for their Lincoln Day Dinner. These gatherings are a good reminder that our party is strongest when neighbors come together, share ideas, and stay involved in the work of keeping Wyoming the best place to live, work, and raise a family.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | CHEYENNE Kelly and I had a great morning in Cheyenne at the Boys & Girls Club Breakfast. We were both inspired by Orion Jean and his message about kindness, leadership, and service. His Race to Kindness is a good reminder that you do not have to wait until you are grown up to make a real difference in your community. Boys & Girls Clubs do important work for kids and families across Wyoming, providing encouragement, opportunity, and a place where young people can grow and thrive
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | | CASPER Kelly and I had a great time at the Wyoming Trucking Association event in Casper. It was informative to hear about what's happening in the industry across Wyoming and beyond. We also had the chance to talk (and be bear hugged) by Wyoming Olympian Rulon Gardner about kids participating in sports and the impact those opportunities can have on young people.
---
| | |
---
|
---
| **BIGHORN BASIN**
---
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| Kelly and I had a great couple of days across the Big Horn Basin, with stops in Lovell, Greybull, Cowley, Frannie, and Deaver. We started with coffee at the Mustang Cafe, toured Queen Bee Gardens with the Zeller family, visited New Horizons Care Center and Lovell’s hospital and clinic, and stopped by S & L Industrial to learn more about their work keeping road construction projects safe across Wyoming. We also toured Dauntless Fitness with Stacy and Devin Bair of Bairco Construction, another good example of Wyoming people investing in their communities and building places where families can live, work, and stay. I appreciated visiting with the mayors of Cowley, Frannie, Deaver, and Lovell about the opportunities and challenges facing their towns. We wrapped up with a great meet and greet at The Bull Pub and a fundraiser at the Cowley Community Center. Thank you to everyone who took time to visit with us and share what matters most across the Basin.
---
|
---

name: Colin Allred
subject: No regrets
body:
I don’t want to wake up the day after Election Day thinking I could’ve done more.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fe42a49a-51e8-488a-bc6e-afacd9ae0ed6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The South Korean stock market is booming. The KOSPI index is [up about 150% from its April 2025 low](https://substack.com/redirect/7b649c1f-7396-4c70-abc8-4907c8cbd1d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and gained ~75% percent in 2025. This is Korea's best performance in over 25 years. But it hasn't stopped this year. It's already up more than 75% and recently touched the 8,000 level for the first time in history. For comparison, it was hovering around 2,500 two years ago.
Regular readers know I've had a lifelong interest in bubbles. Unsurprisingly, performance like this catches my attention. Six days after hitting 8,000, the KOSPI plunged around 12%, triggering downside circuit breakers. The very next day it [bounced 8%](https://substack.com/redirect/d01c6ac3-4fcb-471e-8b85-1c462a418725?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or so, triggering _an upside_ circuit breaker. It was starting to look less like a rally and more like a seizure. My bubble spotting seismograph was indicating tremors afoot.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/73732be4-96c8-4c60-bb39-51b3c53c11b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/KOSPI:IND](https://substack.com/redirect/e9deca8f-8b3d-4004-8042-6e1205d1f333?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The dynamics get more concerning when you acknowledge that the meteoric rally has been largely fueled by the performance of two stocks: **Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix**. Both make the high-bandwidth memory chips that power Nvidia's AI accelerators, and as the media put it bluntly: ["Without Samsung and Hynix, there would be no KOSPI at 6,000"](https://substack.com/redirect/3e682bf8-e188-419a-8560-47730e2e7387?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (not to mention 8,000).
## [The Power of Foxy Thinking](https://substack.com/redirect/30eeadb5-d33b-4177-b852-e4276d51456e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *
---|---|---
| February 16, 2012
[](https://substack.com/redirect/30eeadb5-d33b-4177-b852-e4276d51456e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/30eeadb5-d33b-4177-b852-e4276d51456e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/30eeadb5-d33b-4177-b852-e4276d51456e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
So, the question I ask myself is simple: Is this a bubble?
[My 2011 book on bubbles](https://substack.com/redirect/cc3fbdf2-85fc-4aa2-9dd9-3404270bc9bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) provided a framework for thinking about how to answer this question. The book was based upon a class I taught at Yale, and offered a multi-lens approach to spotting bubbles before they burst. I suggested the use of five lenses (microeconomics, macroeconomics, psychology, politics, and biology) to explore and evaluate sustainability of a boom. At root, it was based on my belief that every perspective is limited, biased, and incomplete...so why not use more than one?
So, let's run the KOSPI through my framework.
**Microeconomics Lens = Bubbly**
Traditional economics suggests that when prices rise, demand is depressed and supply is motivated. But what if the opposite happens? What if higher prices lead to more demand? Might a self-fulfilling dynamic of higher prices leading to higher demand lead to even higher prices (and even higher demand)?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..qidC_55SRtDiXxpjeWEqbRq5RV8ZmYGyxgKLjvN0xZY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=199106701)
The KOSPI is a capitalization weighted index, meaning that the large companies exert more influence on the index. It also means that as heavyweights like Samsung rise in value faster than other components, their weight in the index rises. Continued positive performance compounds this dynamic, leading to a narrowing of breadth and a limited set of companies that drive the index performance. Today, Hynix and Samsung are about 50% of the index...and their earnings depend on a bet that AI infrastructure keeps booming. KB Securities [calls this "a textbook feature of a late-stage bubble"](https://substack.com/redirect/e02f0e95-92d8-42e3-83b1-cb32d4f2344e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): narrowing leadership, concentration in a few names, retail money piling in behind them. It's what happened with the [Nifty Fifty](https://substack.com/redirect/f0271e1e-63b6-45f0-8453-e8c8f564d2dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 1971 and the dotcom stocks in 1999.

**Macroeconomics Lens = Bubbly**
When investors can easily borrow money to invest, my alarm bells go off because this too can create a bubbly dynamic. And through this lens, Korea looks vulnerable. [Margin loan balances hit a record $27 billion on May 15](https://substack.com/redirect/d01c6ac3-4fcb-471e-8b85-1c462a418725?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the very same day the KOSPI touched 8,000. And because the margin interest rates are hovering in the 7%-9% range, this implies retail investors are convinced the index will do better.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e2dfc1e5-90de-4ac7-9a37-d3c94bd6fe85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Seoul_Skyline_including_Lotte_Tower_3.png](https://substack.com/redirect/e5f73d02-3ab4-413a-ae96-9b67b51954bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Credit magnifies both the upside and the downside. Think of it as a two-edged sword, and slight changes in credit can turn a virtuous upside cycle into a vicious downside one. Consider the story of a [Korean civil servant](https://substack.com/redirect/71cf4284-304e-4465-898f-6b6ca53834d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who put 2.3 billion won ($1.7 million) into Hynix, most of it borrowed. Might that end badly? When the KOSPI dropped 12 percent, [forced liquidations surged to 6.5 percent of unsettled trades](https://substack.com/redirect/0fc8cbee-44e1-4fa0-9265-f016d39470d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [$625 billion in market value vanished in a single session](https://substack.com/redirect/70b0f507-007c-4c93-b417-8285abfac12c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**Psychology Lens = Bubbly**
Anyone who studies financial bubbles understands that investors swing between greed and fear. Times with widespread and extreme investor fear are usually good times to buy. The flip side is that widespread and extreme investor greed is a good time to sell. And while data such as foreign investor selling may dampen bubble concerns, Korean retail investors are suffering from stratospheric levels of FOMO (fear of missing out). They've absorbed more than $13.2 billion of foreign investor selling last week alone and are doing so with margin debt.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0e14d33d-63d8-41b3-b438-d40661f6f164?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

Investor overconfidence is a tell-tale sign of bubbly conditions and record Korean margin debt and buying in the face of intense selling from foreigners seems to be pointing to a bubbly KOSPI. ZeroHedge recently called Korean retail investors ["levered to the gills and out of funds, buying with the bank's money."](https://substack.com/redirect/45010ff9-37ba-4c3f-b186-99fb4b68c779?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) South Koreans are even [cashing out insurance policies](https://substack.com/redirect/532c1768-8b87-4ec5-8fb8-faf552e91de2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to play the market, eerily reminiscent of the ordinary people flooding the market for tulip bulbs in 1637, with some even mortgaging their homes. When the smart money exits and the crowd doubles down on borrowed cash, it's starting to look as bubbly as a glass of champagne.
**Political Lens = Sort of Bubbly.**
Government actions often also play role in fueling bubbles. This was true in the great financial crisis as government policies created moral hazard in the mortgage market, allowing a social objective of greater homeownership to create and reinforce risky lending. Political leaders thinking about market performance as a report card for their political acumen is also a concerning dynamic.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..qidC_55SRtDiXxpjeWEqbRq5RV8ZmYGyxgKLjvN0xZY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=199106701)
South Korean President Lee Jae Myung [vowed to hit KOSPI 5,000](https://substack.com/redirect/b672f7b4-5766-49b6-8601-aefed12f518e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and his "Corporate Value-up Program 2.0" mandated governance reforms, strengthened shareholder protections, and [slashed dividend income tax in half to 25%](https://substack.com/redirect/866d26b0-e196-4883-94af-7b243b3d7cb1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). These are real, structural improvements. But when a government explicitly targets a stock index number, it creates a political incentive to keep the party going--and a political cost to letting it correct.
**Biology Lens = Bubbly.**
In the past, I've often described a bubble as an infection that spreads rapidly across a society, eventually reaching epidemic breadth before "herd immunity" leads to a correction. The AI narrative is a great case in point, and it's jumped from Silicon Valley to Seoul in less than two years. Samsung's HBM4 chips, SK Hynix's Nvidia contracts, and the "semiconductor supercycle" are all mechanisms to spread the AI virus to more and more people. _The Korea Times_ identified it as a ["gray rhino": plainly visible, widely recognized, and frequently underestimated](https://substack.com/redirect/b672f7b4-5766-49b6-8601-aefed12f518e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The number of people without any exposure to the artificial intelligence story is dwindling rapidly.
* * *
## [AI Infrastructure: Boom or Bust?](https://substack.com/redirect/66135570-c49e-4406-8629-27c3bccd12e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[In the late 1990s, Lucent Technologies was America's most widely held stock -- a "picks and shovels" play on the internet revolution. The company lent billions to its own customers so they could buy more Lucent equipment. On paper, revenue soared. In reality, Lucent was financing its own demand. When the customers went bust, Lucent nearly followed. The p...](https://substack.com/redirect/66135570-c49e-4406-8629-27c3bccd12e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
Epidemics don't end because the virus weakens. They end when everyone susceptible has already been infected. And with the case of Artificial Intelligence, herd immunity is nigh. In markets, that means the rally ends when everyone who's going to buy has already bought--on margin, at the top. There are no more greater fools left to join the party. When taxicab drivers and bellman start talking about the market, the bubble is close to bursting.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/013ac3de-164b-4cb9-8053-402203a3a418?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**So where does this leave us?**
My assessment is that the Korean markets are very bubbly and unsustainable. Record margin debt, forced liquidations, and professional investors selling while retail investors sell life insurance to buy the market are big bright flashing warning signs. And the fact that everyone, and I mean everyone everywhere, is talking about AI adds a level of caution to anything dependent upon that story continuing.
I've often said that investors are destined to make mistakes. None of us is perfect. But **we do have a choice in the type of mistake to make**. There are errors of commission in which investors own a bubble that eventually leads to losses. And there are errors of omission in which investors miss the final stages of a bubble and miss gains.

Korea is not a market I'd chase. Yes the AI semiconductor story is real and Samsung and Hynix are world-class companies that will benefit from the global transformation underway. But a good story and a good investment are not the same thing, especially when leverage is maxed out, the institutions are heading for the exits, and the government is promising the party won't end. Now's the time to make errors of omission...

Peter,

In 2017, I left my practice as a pediatrician to run for Congress and advocate for the hard-working families of Washington's 8th District.

While so much has changed, **your support has remained constant**. And for that, I'll always be eternally grateful.

Thanks to your support, we've been able to accomplish a lot for working families. But there's still so much to do, which starts with unwinding the actions this administration has taken that are making life so much harder for people I represent. With this election set to determine the future of our country, there's too much at stake to leave things to chance.

clean_body: Peter, In 2017, I left my practice as a pediatrician to run for Congress and advocate for the hard-working families of Washington's 8th District. While so much has changed, your support has remained constant. And for that, I'll always be eternally grateful. Thanks to your support, we've been able to accomplish a lot for working families. But there's still so much to do, which starts with unwinding the actions this administration has taken that are making life so much harder for people I represent. With this election set to determine the future of our country, there's too much at stake to leave things to chance. Protecting abortion rights, securing access to affordable healthcare, putting patients and doctors back in the driver’s seat, cutting costs, putting working families first, making childcare affordable, protecting immigrant communities, and creating an economy that works for everyone — the future of these issues will pivot on the midterms and set the stage for 2028. Remaining in Congress allows me to do the most good I can, and that's why I'm once again asking for your support. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=41406%2E3422442%2Es-pYWB)
Peter,
Here’s the reality in the California governor’s race:
With less than two weeks until the primary election, there’s a chance that **TWO** MAGA Republicans could end up on the general election ballot.
**We need a Democrat who stands out from the pack.** I’m not like most people running for governor. I'm a single mom of three kids who fills the gas tank and pushes the grocery cart just like almost everybody else in our state—and most of all, I can take accountability and laugh at myself too.
**That’s why we made this ad to cut through the noise and make sure voters across California hear what’s at stake.[You can check it out here:](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260524_3_ak.Vfy-ny&refcode=em20260524-41406&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41406%2E3422442%2Es-pYWB)**

And right now, that means breaking through a flood of spending from corporate-funded candidates and a literal billionaire pouring money into this race.
With less than two weeks left until the primary, every day counts. I’m counting on supporters like you, Peter, to help us keep our message in front of voters when it matters most.
**[I’d be honored if you chipped in $5 today to help us reach as many Californians as possible before the primary.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260524_3_ak.Vfy-ny&refcode=em20260524-41406&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=41406%2E3422442%2Es-pYWB)**

Katie

## Iran Peace Deal Takes Shape
The U.S.-Iran agreement Trump says is "largely negotiated" includes a [60-day ceasefire extension](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u3CAQBeCnwR0WHv-AC4qNInc3TaSktLgwtifCYAG7zubpI_IKaedIo_Odnx_rhyFPYf9mTtRli2vAO3ssBdNKyYQLjUWHxp94xkTGO_O2KwiYuBg5jKsz5N_r0Di9IQL2DepOylmKXqmhOXT3CeMnOGFGK9Sk5IazgU3JbZZi7kA1pOs3McLYia4DaJXYpLQOxDBMxirJBoGOSkztr0ihHLj5d3xham08G6-PUq7M-geDhcFy33d75lAzBgsG_swMloqqYUze1fNv65-ZXsjvw5TMKWRyyMuBvJp59fKSnufFKXPrY0ZeIs-0Bwo7g8Uk_nhA_2NWf1i_REuO9V-_1Bnxzt8xXU3S7rrJe8pTBeynIf-vcPmvlV8a_gYAAP__C9qRpA), the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz without tolls, and U.S. sanctions waivers allowing Iran to sell oil freely. American forces would remain in the region during the 60-day window. Trump administration officials say Iran has agreed to dispose of its highly enriched uranium stockpile, but [a senior Iranian source](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGynSAURb8GOxw8ovgKijR2N21KhwtHOQmCA3gd_z5jivzAq_fMmrXXr9fyMhQobj_NjrquaYl4lYC1Yl4om3igsejQhB33lMkEZ267gICRi4HDsDhD4V5k4_SKCNg3qDulvpTop0k2Xve9khNIKfrxy1kYoRvfOL2FGp1yQw8N6YcmBhg60XUA7SRWpawDIeVo7KSYFOioptz-ThSrxzXc6YO5tWlvgva1HoX1PxjMDObrutqMZ8Vcnp3B_D4LRSyFwYwR83YzmJ9n3JvCY6rcbBnRcW-i4w-Xe9p8uDnGTNaj42c2kc6dl5rsn4MC8oKRUuYPhkzk_3NIBnOTtTsuCoHK-Lhvu6Hwz7V-K_BHw98AAAD__x8Wj-k) said that no such agreement exists and that nuclear issues are not part of the current deal. On Sunday, Trump wrote on Truth Social that he had instructed his team [not to rush the deal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1qwzAUBeCnsbYE6ep_0FAo3tKp0NHcWteximwZWUnw2xf3FbqeA9-B83UbbphyWu8fuFBoUxlWeu2ZWqM6pIrrRjhSJMwLLaUmzBGPcQAO5sL1BfQQMeVjUCyGiQhIMgrCWm-5dE6xOUhC960seCW0jzJqHsFNmpRRxqtoWQqnxjVowYUAuDo-WTtG4EoZHJ3tFKeYWqnXn5LWNtOUj_Kkeh3LwnKYW9v2Tr510HfQt_po817GhPnsz1DxSpjfy4o5ftbHsnXQb2Vvewe9EMaA9xq8lZILaxyrIW6vlHPazTl9XzD9Uaz9659ngN8AAAD__24Qdlk), adding that "time is on our side." A senior Trump official told the press the deal was [not expected to be signed Sunday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQRb_GdEFmjIEULqIXIb0iKd7Taks02EMyWYORsSBp9ttX5Be2mpGOdHXu_bx0F2TP0-2KI5k0hG6ibfGUEsWOI04zoSVH6EcaQ2T0Dl-2AwnVQeoD6M4h-1dXZs4MREAqI1PU9bGWqmnK7G6spLIoCKnBpu4r56TuK6mOUFa91k5nbPY0qUEXsigA8kYOdW0dyLKs0Da1KCU5TiHmj8BTutPgX2GlmNswZt7cU5oXoU4CWgHttm1539udCWj3MgJazysJaO3tawb9BDU_kgAl1OlbqFOiZxLqfA0CNMiP__s5_404CfgThoEto3-jRN4v7-8fruzyLBo3b-w9L9UueRuR_Vsq_WrJ1cBPAAAA__9mjoNq) and would take several days to move through approvals.
## Russia Hits Kyiv with Massive Missile Barrage
Russia launched [one of the war's largest aerial assaults](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO3CAURb8Gd4zwAxu7oIgUWUqxaVNab-F552UwjICdFfn6yPmF1Ee6Ovf8etvfkCOnj594kmtH3hN91UitUdm5YHoSegqE8aQzF8YYsPsdFMxSTRKmPSDHvpshuIMISA_kRmtXq_SymOHuVjLH7Nf1Yiv4ZfTvs8Ewr2OwkyU1sLvW1ATTqMYR4Laow1ofQBkzo1-sMIoCt1xuvzOndqcj9vyicvP5HKK7t_asQn8TsAnY8N1fDy4mYPuRGpWEjXPCKGArn7Uyyoifyd-pykovKiQDYYhdnlwrR5LYGvqHfHR-yT8UKdVH7wK22nLpQm8chP4-ag2zXpQZigvPL46R63y5fpzI8Z9b-6-gLwd_AwAA__-KaYtH) on Ukraine overnight Sunday, firing 90 missiles and 600 drones in a strike that killed at least four people and injured 83. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Kyiv was the primary target. Among the weapons used was the Oreshnik, [a nuclear-capable hypersonic ballistic missile](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3O2zAQRE8jdTRWS1EkCxZp3DltSmFNruyNqR9QtA3dPlCu8JWDAQZv3p_beCPJsjx-08yhTuu48HfPXCuXUQotG1PkxJRnntcilBMdcUTAQYFRaMZEko-xb1OYmJF1y6Gz1lvQzvXtM_QaDHSoB4igtWMi0Kg1aO_IM5hWwrkGBk0HXYd4cTBZGxNC3w8UnW164CR1LZe_qyz1yVM-1g-XS1znNodnrdve6F8NXhu80nYeOKszlCoxc4PX8t53IfV-FZKF1ZeKeh3yUbPsu2RWqawLK6qV4kt574iJ7sZpHUl7ix6SZ0ar7R3YtCWk7Ss5yz6cdI-ZJP-nqT9S-An4LwAA__-fn4NX) that reportedly flies at more than 10 times the speed of sound. Sunday's launch marked only the third combat use of the system in the war. [Residential buildings, a school, a water supply facility](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOrDAQRE8D2SC7MTYEDn5CNj_dEDV2M9OrBiNjDeL2K_YKm5VU0ivV-3pOT2Th7fUfV_JlSdNG5yFUCuWJM247YaBIKCutKTNKxCtMoMA-VPeAborIck2mjn4hAmpr8tq5wam270399rafh1aTAbOoodMBMDhjZ4OzG1DZuWZ_01QHnVZaAzS9WpwLEZQxFkPvKqMockm5-U68lTctcqUP5SaktRb_LmU_qvZfBWMF43mezTyHu6tgvM9UMGIuHITuGOTabd_qa-9SnX3cTxbhw94rrxVZfqnlTyo-Hn4CAAD__8-lcU4), and the Chernobyl Museum in Kyiv were among the damaged sites. Ukraine's interior minister called the museum strike "a deliberate attack on history, memory, and truth." Russia said the assault was retaliation for a Ukrainian drone attack on a student dormitory in Russian-occupied Starobilsk, which Kyiv denies. European leaders condemned the strike, and [Poland scrambled fighter jets](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L9ugzAQx_GngY3ouJhABg9d2NK1o3Wxz8k1_oOMS8TbV_QVuv_0_Ui_r5u5kQRJj0-KrKvPJvF7DVwrFyOF0sJk2TGFyDEXoeBotwYBLx0MHQ7GkYTdqNZpz4x8bln343gd4TxNqn3qOw2WyQGjvQNe7dRfvec7DkCslIdW9FGDAYce-h7xNIEfR-sQlLqQncZGATupuZy-s6T6ZB_2vHE52RzboJ-1Lmtz_mhwbnB-7bJJcrxwcpzqsWlwLj_rKpQ6qpXsq4u0d6i6w21wbot2y1tCkPVyYI9IEv7i9V-PbBp_AwAA__8j_nTX) in response.
## Memorial Day Cookouts Cost More This Year
Americans firing up the grill this Memorial Day are paying noticeably more for backyard staples, with [ground beef prices up 14.5% and steak up 16.1%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1yhCAUx0-jHQ6iqFtQpLHbtCmdJzwXEuDtAK7x9hkzkxOk_3_-Pu7LHZx38fEOAVXZaIl4ZI-lYFpcgvhE0GgQfMBAyYE3cOpFcDEwLpmQiwHnz6WvjdoQBXY1qnYcbyPvpqmvrdKdkf0AurvpoW_XAaRsYTAdb6FDva61U1cal0K2vG2FaCa-jaM2gveXbxqrnqNxhVLzSS4Wi5s_6YWp0RRqr2wpz1x1b5WYKzEfx9Fs9L3u2UXM-dJUYkZNkcJZidlSLi4-2N8dZuBkmuiL9sIsJszM0sHCri3TtHvDNOVSJ2Weh_Pe5eHa8wjg_G9_-Re0lxI_AQAA__-ewINt) year over year, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics' April inflation report. name: Kevin Ford for State Senate
subject: Remembering Our Fallen Heroes
body:
Their service. Their sacrifice. Our remembrance. | | | [CLICK HERE TO LEARN MORE ABOUT KEVIN FORD JR](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6a142cccf19ce44a66365ccd&u=https%3A%2F%2Fkfordjr.com%2Fmeetkford%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69f2afdb5a8a1268a83b8431%26ss_email_id%3D6a142cccf19ce44a66365ccd%26ss_campaign_name%3DRemembering%2BOur%2BFallen%2BHeroes%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-05-25T11%253A04%253A48Z&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69f2afdb5a8a1268a83b8431&l=en-US&s=75E3MjV8zhbiJ8VA6L6TcJ759d0%3D)
---
| |
---
#### Today, we pause to honor the men and women who gave their lives in service to this country.
#### Maryland has a long and proud connection to military service. From communities across our state, generations of service members answered the call and carried the responsibility of defending both our nation and the people they loved back home.
#### Memorial Day is not simply about ceremony. It is about remembering the cost of sacrifice and recognizing the families who continue to carry that loss every day.
#### This Memorial Day, we honor the brave Americans who gave their lives in service to our nation. May we never forget their sacrifice, and may we continue the work of supporting the veterans, families, and communities they fought to protect.
#### As we spend time with loved ones this weekend, I hope we also take a moment to reflect on those who never had the opportunity to return home.
#### To every military family in District 24 and across Maryland, we honor and remember your sacrifice.
#### Wishing you a safe and meaningful Memorial Day.
#### Kevin Ford, Jr.
